title: Simple & basic plastic Ziplock bag holder; great for those who love yellow; PRICEY
text:
Simple & basic plastic Ziplock bag holder; great for those who love yellow; PRICEY. This is a simple and basic but nice four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. This can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it. There are two plastic stickies with nubs provided but I recommend securing it to a stud with actual screws and mollies and not use what is provided. What I like is that the organizer opens for loading.

Overall, this is an excellent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. It is definitely an attractive unit even though it is plastic. The biggest negative is that it is hard to see the etched labels for each compartment. I do wish they provided screws with mollies and some rubberized "circles" on the bottom to keep it from sliding around or scratching a wall. I ordered this for a friend who loves the color yellow and I believe she will appreciate this.

The current price of $36.99 is on the very high side of competitively priced for this, especially since it is plastic. Other options that are available are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.

product_metadata.title: Datoua Ziplock Bag Storage Organizer, Acrylic Kitchen Drawer Baggie Box, Plastic Bag Organizer for Ziploc, Solimo, Hefty, Glad, Compatible With Gallon, Quart, Sandwich, Snack Variety Size Bag (Green)
features: 【Exquisite Design】Our ziplock bag organizer uses a curved design that is different from other storage bag organizer to reduce the extra damage caused by sharp corners. The clever combination of appearance and color makes our ziploc bag storage organizer a work of art in the kitchen.

【Keep Organized】This baggie organizer fits perfectly in your kitchen drawer and cleans it up nicely. No more messy food-storage plastic bags and broken boxes. Collect bags in this kitchen drawer organizer, and keep your kitchen tidy. The size is 11.8*11.8*3.4 inches (l×w×h).

【Sturdy & Durable】This sandwich bag organizer is made of safe and waterproof ABS. It has excellent durability and is easy to clean, making it suitable for use in the kitchen. Two hooks are provided for you to hang the ziplock organizer on the wall. All packed in an elegant ready-to-gift box!

【Wide Applicability】The acrylic ziplock bag storage organizer is compatible with most bag brands. It has four compartments for a variety of large and small size storage bags, compatible with Ziploc, Solimo, Hefty, Glad, and more bag brands. There are four logos on the box, which can be convenient for you to take the bag you want.

【Easy to Use】The plastic bag drawer organizer has a clever occlusion structure that requires no assembly. You can easily open the top lid to put in many ziplock bags. The powerful bite holds the cover firmly together during extraction, so you don't need to worry about the cap coming off.
